description: This file contains functions for parsing and generating descriptions and links for calendar events, including handling HTML to plain text conversion, generating event details, and managing video call URLs. It also includes functions for constructing booking, cancel, and reschedule links, and rendering rich HTML descriptions of events.

methods.name: getWhat
methods.description: Generates a string describing the 'what' aspect of an event, using translation function.

methods.name: getWhen
methods.description: Constructs a string indicating the event's timezone information based on organizer and attendee time zones.

methods.name: getWho
methods.description: Builds a string listing the organizer, attendees, and team members involved in the event.

methods.name: getAdditionalNotes
methods.description: Returns formatted additional notes if provided.

methods.name: getUserFieldsResponses
methods.description: Generates a string of user responses associated with the event, based on label-value mappings.

methods.name: getAppsStatus
methods.description: Creates a formatted string summarizing the status of various apps related to the event.

methods.name: htmlToPlainText
methods.description: Converts HTML content into plain text, preserving links and line breaks.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a plain text description of the event, converting HTML to text.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Determines the event location or video call URL based on event data.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Extracts provider name from location string, especially for integrations.

methods.name: getUid
methods.description: Returns the provided UID or generates a new short UUID.

methods.name: getBookingUrl
methods.description: Constructs a booking URL for the event, considering platform and attendee info.

methods.name: getPlatformManageLink
methods.description: Builds a management link for platform-based booking systems, including reschedule and cancel options.

methods.name: getManageLink
methods.description: Returns a management link, either platform-specific or default.

methods.name: getPlatformCancelLink
methods.description: Creates a cancel link for platform-based booking systems.

methods.name: getCancelLink
methods.description: Generates a cancel link, either platform-specific or standard.

methods.name: getPlatformRescheduleLink
methods.description: Creates a reschedule link for platform-based booking systems.

methods.name: getRescheduleLink
methods.description: Returns a reschedule link, either platform-specific or standard.

methods.name: getRichDescriptionHTML
methods.description: Generates an HTML formatted detailed description of the event, including links and sections.

methods.name: getRichDescription
methods.description: Generates a plain text detailed description of the event, including all sections.

methods.name: getCancellationReason
methods.description: Returns a formatted cancellation reason string.

methods.name: isDailyVideoCall
methods.description: Checks if the video call type is 'daily_video'.

methods.name: getPublicVideoCallUrl
methods.description: Constructs a public URL for a daily video call.

methods.name: getVideoCallUrlFromCalEvent
methods.description: Extracts the video call URL from event data, considering different types.

methods.name: getVideoCallPassword
methods.description: Returns the password for a video call, empty for daily video calls.
